feed.title: Bullpen Phone: St. Louis Cardinals reporter posts

entry.title: St. Louis Cardinals: rotation: Starter market absolutely flying, down to the guys taking one- and two-year deals already. If the Cardinals do indeed plan to add a big-league deal there — and I believe they do — seems like that’s bound to happen in the next few days at most.
Nolan Gorman: Cardinals say they’ve non-tendered Nolan Gorman and Max Rajcic, officially. 40-player goes to 39.
St. Louis Cardinals offseason notes: Cardinals selected Jesús Báez and Jacob Odle. Max Rajcic DFA. 40-man goes full.

Sal Stewart: Sal Stewart's ROY victory came as zero surprise to anyone with their eye on the tea leaves. JJ Wetherholt's slip back to third, however, was another glimpse into a problem the Cardinals need to mind -- chosen irrelevance, and how they get out: words-about-birds.beehiiv.com/p/in-wetherh...

JoJo Romero: DG reporting this morning that the Cardinals have an interest in a reunion with JoJo Romero. Source this afternoon told me that interest is definitely mutual. We’ll see if that’s enough to get a deal done.

St. Louis Cardinals staff and front office: Not much on the news front from the Cardinals presser outside of the reason to call it. No announcement yet on the coaching staff (and it will still be perhaps a week), no immediate internal promotions to announce to backfill.

Ryne Stanek: Today is the 40-man compliance deadline and the official opening of free agency. The Cardinals will have to finalize their decline of Ryne Stanek’s option, as @dgoold.bsky.social reported last night. They also haven’t yet formally activated Max Rajcic from the 60-day IL.
